violations.why: The higher-priority compute ISR can preempt RR ISR between its write and read, so the read sees 1 instead of 0.
The compute ISR can write between the two reads in the RR ISR, so they see different values.
The compute ISR can preempt the FL ISR between its two writes and read an intermediate state.
The compute ISR can overwrite RT4 between the RR ISR's write and its read.
The compute ISR can change RT4 between the RR ISR's two reads.
The compute ISR can overwrite RT4 between the FL ISR's write and its read.
The compute ISR can change RT4 between the FL ISR's two reads.
The compute ISR can overwrite RT_h between the RR ISR's write and its later read.
The compute ISR can overwrite RT_h between the RR ISR's write and its later read in the else branch.
The compute ISR can overwrite RT3 between the FL ISR's write and its later read.
The compute ISR can overwrite RT3 between the FL ISR's write and its later read in the else branch.
